findings.title: [P0] Return the identifier under the declared `id` property
findings.body: `loadUser` is declared to return `Promise<User>`, and the unchanged exported type is `User = { id: string; name: string }` (src/users.ts:7). The changed return literal `{ userId: row.id, name: row.display_name }` (src/users.ts:11) is missing the required `id` property and adds an excess `userId` property, so the file cannot type-check under any TypeScript configuration (TS2741/TS2353), and every call returns an object violating its own exported contract — consumers reading `user.id` get `undefined` on every invocation, regardless of input. The repo has no callers, tests, or tsconfig that mask this; the repo contains only this file. Either revert the key to `id`, or, if a rename is truly intended, update `User` and every consumer in the same change — which contradicts this PR's stated goal of preserving existing contracts.
